title: The chosen as-of date survives a reload and browser Back
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Set the date chip to the 15th of last month.
  4. Reload the page.
  5. Read the date chip.
  6. Click "A/R Aging Summary".
  7. Press the browser Back button.
  8. Read the date chip.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • the chip still shows the 15th of last month.

Step 8:

  • A/R Aging Detail is back on the 15th of last month.

Why this matters: Users share and revisit a report for a given date.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingSummaryReport.vue:154-155; app/src/composables/useReportFilters.ts:243-245. V1 code, quoted: `const SYNC_KEYS = ['asOfDate'];`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-015) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.

AUTOMATION: READY
